original.statement: The argocd-cm ConfigMap keys for repositories (repositories, repository.credentials, helm.repositories) have been removed and are no longer supported in Argo CD 3.0.

corrected.statement: Argo CD 3.0 no longer supports legacy repository configuration in the argocd-cm ConfigMap. Environments that set any of the data keys repositories, repository.credentials or helm.repositories in argocd-cm are exposed and must convert those repositories to Secrets.

decision.reason: The detection command in [ev-ea324615706c] reads three argocd-cm data keys: repositories, repository.credentials and helm.repositories. It says you are not impacted only when all three are empty (`[, , ]`). So an environment is exposed when any one of these keys is set. The proposed condition checks only data.repositories, which is too narrow: it misses environments that set only repository.credentials or only helm.repositories.
